scope: Provisional scenario ranking, not an operational optimization approval
notes: Speed utility is modeled dispatch reduction percentage divided by 10, clipped to [-1,1]
Profit utility is modeled contribution change divided by max(5% of absolute baseline modeled contribution,100 source monetary units), clipped to [-1,1]
Default recommendations must preserve base-case modeled contribution; strict_all_cases requires preservation across every sensitivity case
Tradeoff mode can expose modeled contribution losses for investigation when the user explicitly chooses it
Unknown capacity/compatibility permits provisional investigation only; explicit restrictions block options
The capacity-aware portfolio is greedy, not a globally optimal assignment solution
Evidence confidence is a readiness score, not a probability or a statistical confidence interval
